ex.en: The electron carries a negative charge and moves around the nucleus.
ex.zh: 电子带负电，围绕原子核运动。

words.note: electron 由 electric 加 -on 构成，形容词为 electronic。

ex.en: The bullet was embedded deeply in the wall of the old house.
ex.zh: 子弹深深嵌在旧屋的墙里。

words.note: embed 常用被动 be embedded in，过去式双写 d。

ex.en: I am inclined to agree with you on this point.
ex.zh: 在这一点上我倾向于同意你的看法。

words.note: be inclined to 意为倾向于，比 want to 更正式。

ex.en: The new policy aims to elevate the status of rural teachers.
ex.zh: 新政策旨在提升农村教师的地位。

words.note: elevate 指位置或地位上升，也可指提高风险等。

ex.en: The area was designated as a nature reserve twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 这片区域二十年前被指定为自然保护区。

words.note: designate 常用 be designated as 结构。

ex.en: She is one of the most promising young researchers in her field.
ex.zh: 她是本领域最有前途的年轻研究者之一。

words.note: promising 由 promise 加 -ing 而来，指有希望的。

ex.en: The company's slick advertising made the product seem better than it was.
ex.zh: 公司圆滑的广告让产品显得比实际更好。

words.note: slick 褒义指娴熟利落，贬义指油滑、华而不实。

ex.en: The committee decided that the plan was not practicable at this stage.
ex.zh: 委员会认定该计划现阶段不可行。

words.note: practicable 指方案可实施；practical 多指实用的。

ex.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget for next year.
ex.zh: 议程第一项是明年的预算。

words.note: item 指清单中的一项；新闻一条常说 a news item。

ex.en: The company hired legal counsel to review the contract before signing.
ex.zh: 公司在签约前聘请法律顾问审阅合同。

words.note: counsel 作忠告时不可数，作律师指法律顾问。

ex.en: The artist spent two weeks painting the mountains on canvas.
ex.zh: 那位艺术家花了两周时间在画布上画这些山。

words.note: canvas 与 canvass（拉票）形近，勿混。

ex.en: The superintendent of the building fixed the broken elevator within an hour.
ex.zh: 楼宇管理员一小时内修好了坏掉的电梯。

words.note: superintendent 由 super- 加 intendent 构成，指监管人。

ex.en: In all probability, the meeting will be postponed until next week.
ex.zh: 会议很可能推迟到下周。

words.note: in all probability 意为十有八九；形容词是 probable。

ex.en: The main point of contention was how to share the additional costs.
ex.zh: 争论的焦点是如何分摊额外费用。

words.note: contention 指争论或论点；in contention 意为有胜算。

ex.en: He left the company to pursue his lofty goal of teaching in the countryside.
ex.zh: 他离开公司去实现去乡村教书的崇高目标。

words.note: lofty 可指崇高的，也可指高傲的，感情色彩看语境。

ex.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to format the report.
ex.zh: 老师就如何排版报告给出了明确指示。

words.note: explicit 与 implicit 相对，指明确说出、不含糊。

ex.en: You can rely on him to keep the schedule as planned.
ex.zh: 你可以指望他按计划推进日程。

words.note: rely 是不及物动词，必须接 on 或 upon。

ex.en: Prices began to slide after the report on falling demand came out.
ex.zh: 需求下降的报告发布后，价格开始下滑。

words.note: slide 的过去式是 slid；slide into 指不知不觉陷入。

ex.en: The factory now utilizes solar energy to run most of its machines.
ex.zh: 工厂如今利用太阳能驱动大部分机器。

words.note: utilize 比 use 正式，强调有效利用资源或机会。

ex.en: We found ourselves in a sticky situation when the car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时我们陷入了一个棘手的处境。

words.note: sticky 除黏的外，口语可指棘手、难办的。

ex.en: This custom still prevails in some remote villages of the province.
ex.zh: 这一风俗在该省一些偏远村庄仍然盛行。

words.note: prevail 指盛行或获胜；prevail over 强调占上风。

ex.en: Excessive noise at night can seriously affect people's health.
ex.zh: 夜间过大的噪音会严重影响人们的健康。

words.note: excessive 带贬义，指超出合理限度；名词为 excess。

ex.en: The company issued a firm denial of the rumors about layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司坚决否认了有关裁员的传言。

words.note: in denial 指拒绝面对事实；动词为 deny。

ex.en: The soldiers carried out an assault on the enemy camp before dawn.
ex.zh: 士兵们在黎明前对敌营发动了攻击。

words.note: assault 常与 on 连用，指人身攻击或猛烈批评。

ex.en: There is an implicit warning in the way she phrased the question.
ex.zh: 她提问的方式中含有一种隐含的警告。

words.note: implicit 与 explicit 相反，指含蓄的、不言明的。

ex.en: The government has promised to intensify efforts to reduce air pollution.
ex.zh: 政府承诺加大力度减少空气污染。

words.note: intensify 由 intense 加 -ify 构成，表示使更强。

ex.en: The room was decorated in soft colors with a feminine touch.
ex.zh: 房间用柔和色彩装饰，带有女性气息。

words.note: feminine 指女性特质；female 只指性别，注意区分。

ex.en: Tests showed that the purity of the local water had improved.
ex.zh: 检测显示当地水的纯净度有所提高。

words.note: purity 由 pure 加 -ity 构成，指纯净或纯洁。

ex.en: His sleep pattern changed completely after he started working nights.
ex.zh: 开始上夜班后，他的睡眠规律完全变了。

words.note: pattern 后常接 of，如 a pattern of change；也指图案。

ex.en: The two companies finally settled the dispute out of court.
ex.zh: 两家公司最终在庭外解决了争端。

words.note: settle 可指安家、解决或支付；settle down 指安定下来。
